evidence_policy: All packets are fictional, closed-book evaluation inputs, not issuer disclosures. Treat absent evidence as unavailable. Give the model the user_prompt and evidence_packet, but keep expected_checks and forbidden_claims private to the evaluator.
run_protocol: Start each case in a fresh conversation with the current canonical skill modules; record model/version, skill commit, run date, loading profile and exact prompt.
Use only the supplied evidence packet. The prompt requests a focused rule assessment, not an invented complete company report.
Save the unedited response outside the skill repository. If a full analysis JSON is separately requested, validate it with scripts/validate_analysis.py; JSON validity alone does not pass the rubric.
For each expected check record pass/fail and an exact response excerpt; separately flag each forbidden claim. Report missing evidence rather than guessing.
Any false cash-income Pass, unsupported Strong Buy or contradictory terminal value fails the case regardless of other checks. Human review of evidence and reasoning remains required.
Report per-case results and latency for actual runs only. Contract regression results and packet-format tests are not model evaluation results.

cases.user_prompt: Screen this fictional security against my hard 5% recurring net cash yield minimum. Determine Yield Fit and Full Analysis Recommended using only the packet; do not forecast.

evidence_packet.facts: Current unadjusted price HKD 10 per ordinary share.

Paid TTM cash and latest FY payouts: recurring ordinary HKD 0.40 plus one-off disposal-funded special HKD 0.50. Same share/currency basis; verified withholding 0%; before fees. Target uses that same before-fee basis.

expected_checks: Keep 9% total paid TTM yield separate from 4% recurring screening yield.
Yield Fit Below target; gap -1 percentage point; Full Analysis Recommended No.
forbidden_claims: Passing the 5% recurring-income minimum using the special.
A normalized N, forecast DPS, buy zone or Strong Buy.

cases.user_prompt: Assess the hard 5% net-yield screen from this fictional packet. Does the stock pass, fail or need more evidence?

evidence_packet.facts: The same ordinary cash dividend has two supported custody/withholding outcomes. Net yields on the target's before-fee basis are 4.5% and 5.5%; applicable custody treatment is unresolved. No independent fundamental hazard has been established.

expected_checks: Yield Fit Unclear, no fabricated point gap.
Recommend Watch and identify custody/tax evidence needed.
forbidden_claims: A definitive minimum Pass or Below target.
A zero-withholding assumption chosen just to meet the target.

cases.user_prompt: Can the proposed insurer cash coverage and buy zone be used? Give a focused assessment of this fictional analyst note; do not fill missing financials.

evidence_packet.facts: OPAT 100 and a 40% earnings payout policy are disclosed. The note assumes FCF=OPAT x 60%=60 and therefore coverage=1.5x. New-business capital strain, subsidiary dividend restrictions and parent remittances are all missing.

expected_checks: Reject OPAT x 60% as verified cash or remittable capital.
Coverage unavailable, safety Unclear and valuation suspended; name the missing capital/remittance bridge.
forbidden_claims: Treating low accounting payout as sufficient cash evidence.

cases.user_prompt: Audit the proposed 13.33% cash yield and Strong Buy against a hard 10% cash-income requirement. Use only this fictional distribution packet.

evidence_packet.facts: Price 30. Cash-equivalent stock entitlement 4 per share. All distributions are mandatory issuer shares with no cash alternative, and issuer cash settlement is zero. No other cash dividend is scheduled.

expected_checks: Do not treat entitlement value 4 as spendable cash DPS.
Confirmed scheduled cash income is zero; the positive hard income minimum is not met.
Suspend cash-dividend valuation and reject Strong Buy; describe stock entitlements separately.
forbidden_claims: 13.33% cash income or an income Pass.
Valuing the mandatory stock entitlement as a perpetual cash dividend.

cases.user_prompt: Audit this fictional ordinary-income Strong Buy conclusion. Is the action eligibility justified without changing the supplied assumptions?

evidence_packet.facts: Price 30; proposed mid-cycle net N=4, Bear B=3.2, r_low=8%, r_high=10%, Strong Buy boundary=32. The net amounts were retained from an earlier zero-tax assumption. Current withholding rate is null and basis unknown; no independently reconciled net receipts support the amounts. High confidence and Strong safety are only the analyst's top-level labels.

expected_checks: The arithmetic boundary is 32 only under the unverified net-dividend inputs.
Unresolved tax makes action diagnostic only, not Strong Buy or Core income.
If illustrating 20% withholding on those originally gross amounts, the Bear boundary is 25.6 and price 30 is outside it; label 20% illustrative, not the actual tax rate.
forbidden_claims: The mid_cycle basis bypasses tax evidence requirements.

cases.user_prompt: Audit the normalized dividend and action label in this fictional note. Distinguish numerical consistency from evidence quality.

evidence_packet.facts: Base FY+1, FY+2 and FY+3 DPS are each 4, explicitly marked illustrative rather than evidence-backed. N uses three_year_base_average=4, tax is verified zero and FX/unit conversion is 1. The author adds High confidence and requests Strong Buy.

expected_checks: The mean is arithmetically 4 but remains illustrative.
Restrict the normalized comparison to diagnostic use and reject Strong Buy.
Explain what operating/payout/share evidence would support the inputs.
forbidden_claims: Averaging illustrative dividends makes them evidence-backed.
A High label overrides the DPS source classification.

cases.user_prompt: Audit whether this fictional three-year dividend model can keep its terminal value unchanged after the announced year-five reset.

evidence_packet.facts: Base DPS years 1-4: 4, 4.08, 4.1616, 4.244832. All amounts are funded and use verified zero tax, no fees, constant FX and constant share count. Model R=9%, terminal g=2%, terminal boundary at year 3, first terminal DPS=4.244832; baseline value=57.142857142857146.

A permanent payout reset is already known: year-five DPS is 0.432972864, not 4.32972864. Policy-adjustment evidence supports the cut. The proposed valuation still assumes 2% perpetual growth from year 4.

expected_checks: Identify the tenfold year-five contradiction despite matching year four.
Reject unchanged early-terminal value; extend the explicit/transition path through the reset before rebuilding terminal cash.
Do not add year-five cash separately on top of an overlapping perpetuity.
forbidden_claims: The unchanged 57.142857 value is still consistent.
Calling the permanent known payout reset transient to preserve terminal assumptions.

cases.user_prompt: Calculate investor cash-election DPS and yield from this fictional packet, and explain how it differs from issuer settlement. Do not make a buy recommendation from these inputs alone.

evidence_packet.facts: Ordinary attributable profit 100, policy payout 50%, sufficient recurring FAD and actual capacity 70, 100 dividend-entitled shares. Optional scrip retains 40% of issuer settlement cash. This investor chooses the supported all-cash option; verified withholding 10%, price 10, no fees, same currency/share units.

expected_checks: Total entitlement 50, issuer cash settlement 30, investor gross cash-option DPS 0.50.
Net DPS 0.45 and net yield 4.5%; optional scrip does not reduce the cash-option DPS.
Do not infer a position size or Strong Buy from cash coverage alone.
forbidden_claims: Using cash settlement 30/100 to report gross DPS 0.30.
Treating optional scrip like a mandatory stock-only distribution.
